bio: The name ‘Shinka’ suggests dazzling cuisine, created with care. Guided by the idea of expressing Japanese spirit through Western technique, the kitchen marries Japanese ingredients with French and Italian methods. Combinations are free-ranging, from Japanese dashi with caviar to young sweetfish wrapped in kadaif and fried crisp. Rice cooked in a Western cast-iron pot also reflects the theme. The fusion of Japanese and Western sensibilities extends to the tableware too, from lacquer bowls to Old Imari and Limoges porcelain.
